mapper.select: SELECT review_no, item_no, writer_email, target_email, rating, content, reg_time FROM tbl_review WHERE target_email = #{targetEmail} ORDER BY reg_time DESC
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM tbl_review WHERE target_email = #{targetEmail}
